detail.title: Fidelity Thresholds for Prebiotic Evolution
detail.summary: Minimal copying fidelity is essential for open-ended evolution. In non-templated systems, heredity relies on compositional stability rather than precise sequence copying, requiring different error thresholds based on kinetic robustness.
detail.reason: Synthesis-ready project requires a notebook to facilitate further focused research.
